svg.text: drawn at 1 tile = 2500 px; real size 0.17 tile (0.5 m) across
footprint 0.17 tile (0.5 m); blades lean 10-35 deg outward, more at the rim
tips: grass.3 45% / grass.2 35% / grass.1 12%; root grass.4; straw 8% (dust.3 to limestone.3)
root shading: occlusion 0.65 at the root to 1.0 at 40% height (a light term, not a colour key)
B. The blade at each LOD
width drawn x3 for legibility; height to scale with panel A
LOD0 at z >= 1.5, LOD1 0.9 to 1.5, LOD2 below 0.9
base 0.012 tile (3.6 cm), floor 1 device px on screen
C. Play zoom z1, drawn x4: legacy today (unchanged) and the node field, beside a 0.6-tile figure
legacy: 8-14 flat strokes a tile + about 0.36 tufts (unchanged)
node: about 8.4 clumps a tile (LOD1, 10 blades), patchy, never a lawn
selection ring draws OVER the grass
